metadata.dcterms:title: arXiv:math/0008027v1 [math.GT] 3 Aug 2000
metadata.dcterms:creator: YOKOTA, HYPERBOLIC KNOT AFTER Y.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: I follow Y. Yokota to explain how to obtain a tetrahedron de- composition of the complement of a hyperbolic knot and compare it with the asymptotic behavior of Kashaev’s link invariant using the ﬁgure-eight knot as an example.
